allOf.$comment: Family rule (derivation spec §4, Oct 30, 2026): section.family_visible true requires a private posture — status private or demo-only, both of which derive Tier=Private. Family=True forces Tier=Private; alongside status public the manifest fails validation in the pull tool. The forcing resolves toward private, never toward public, and nothing overrides it.

description: One per repo, at the root — and ONLY there (one project = one repo; Oct 29, 2026). A project's publish.json is the single source of its display data: title, blurb, links, status, shelf, and audience flags. Displays (the private section, the portfolio gate) PULL each manifest from the project's own repo at build time; no hand-maintained copies exist anywhere. There is deliberately no `repo` URL field: a card's Repo link is structural, derived by the consumer from the repo the manifest was pulled from, and Repo links are owner-view only. See PUBLISH-MANIFEST-SPEC (fleet records) and publish-registry/README.md.

link_audiences.description: Per-link-kind audience narrowing for section entries. Audiences are 'owner' and 'family'. Defaults: every kind reaches both audiences, EXCEPT 'repo', which is owner-only by construction (the family dataset never carries a Repo link, and a declaration may narrow further but never widen 'repo' into the family audience — consumers fail on the attempt). Use this only to narrow a kind to the owner view, e.g. {"demo": ["owner"]}.
